arguments.user_request: Customer asks whether an exception or alternative is available to return an unused Cotton kurta after the change-of-mind return window.
arguments.facts_found: User U022 verified using registered email. Order O0015 belongs to U022 and is Delivered. Item I0015 is a Cotton kurta, clothing category, price ₹1499, quantity 1. Delivered 2026-09-04 at 12:00 IST; today is 2026-09-15, day 11. Inclusive 10-day return window ended 2026-09-14. Customer confirms item is unworn and unused; reason is change of mind, not damage, defect, or wrong item. Shipping fee ₹49; payment method UPI. Refund history shows one qualifying refund in the last 90 days and no refunds on O0015. Order details show evidence photo uploaded, though evidence is not required for change of mind. Promised and actual delivery dates were both 2026-09-04, so order was not late. No return or refund has been created.
arguments.rule_triggered: A3: Policy does not provide an exception process or alternative return option for this request. E1: Clothing return window is 10 calendar days from delivery, counting delivery as day 0; this request is outside the window.
arguments.what_user_was_told: Customer was told the return window ended 14 September and the unused kurta is no longer eligible for a change-of-mind return. On requesting an exception, customer was told policy provides no exception or alternative return option after the window, and the request would be escalated for human review without any guarantee of approval.
